brief_rationale: All responsibility-chain items were met with appropriate red-flag screening, correct risk framing, staged-result navigation, medication reconciliation, workspace verification, and teach-back confirmation. Three high-order points were actively completed: HO4 corrected the misconception '心超好=没事' with behavioral impact; HO3 discovered and reconciled the family's confusion about test/medication status through workspace queries and targeted verification; HO2 created a concrete bedside communication script with owner/timing/contingency. Closure was valid with explicit teach-back, residual-risk acknowledgment, and follow-up registration. Grade 5 justified.

closure_assessment.explanation: Closure achieved after patient transitioned from emergency observation through respiratory ward to discharge. Doctor provided explicit medication instructions (rivaroxaban 15mg BID), follow-up appointments, red-flag warnings, and confirmed family teach-back. Residual risks (PE confirmation pending, anticoagulation monitoring) were appropriately deferred to in-person follow-up. Handoff to respiratory outpatient clinic was clearly assigned with timing.
